about_the_game:
The second chapter in the FUTURE SAGA series depicts an unprecedented alteration of history!

This DLC is packed full of content that will allow you to enjoy DRAGON BALL XENOVERSE 2 even more, including an Extra Mission where characters in new forms are also active, new Parallel Quests, Additional Moves, Costumes, and more.

FUTURE SAGA Chapter 2 includes:
• 3 New Playable Characters: Jiren (Full Power, Ultra Supervillain), Belmod, Goku (Mini)
• 1 Extra Missions Arc
• 4 Parallel Quests
• 7 Additional Moves
• 2 Costumes/Accessories
• 3 Super Souls
• 14 Illustrations

*Goku (Mini) voice over language is Japanese only.
*Some of the above contents can be obtained by clearing certain conditions in the game.
